desc: Derive the contribution formula for a fixed value \(x\) across all permutations, accounting for decimal shifts caused by later elements.
Determine a compact generating-function method to sum weighted suffix subsets, including factorial multiplicities.
Exploit the small number of distinct digit lengths to aggregate values \(1,\dots,N\) by length and exclude the distinguished value efficiently.
Prove the combinatorial multiplicities for arrangements before and after a fixed element.
Implement the modular arithmetic algorithm in Python for \(N \le 2\times10^5\), with appropriate precomputations and stdin/stdout handling.
